design: Create a production pixel-art sprite design reference of a PEGASUS KNIGHT for this established retro tactics game. Image1 is our APPROVED archer palette and flat pixel rendering reference; image2 is the native Pegasus anatomy/weapon silhouette to preserve. FOUR well-separated complete figures on TRANSPARENT background arranged 2x2: upper-left mounted left-facing side view with wings lifted, upper-right mounted back view with wings close, bottom-left mounted FRONT view, bottom-right left-facing flying combat three-quarter view with two wings raised in V and a horizontal spear. Same ONE young adult woman rider and same white winged horse in all views, no background, no labels. Character: solid dusty-coral red ponytail with NO highlights, face natural peach with readable navy eye, small ivory brow/wing band; simple blue fitted short tunic over ivory light breastplate and shoulder guards, short blue skirt edged in ivory, ivory gloves and boots/navy soles. White Pegasus with ivory/white broad feather wings, navy mane and tail, blue saddle/harness with a SMALL coral accent; NOT a unicorn, no horn, no bat wings, no claws. Long intact ivory steel SPEAR, navy shaft, small coral grip binding; no sword/shield/bow. Wings attached anatomically behind shoulders, 4 horse legs, rider legs resting at saddle sides. Strict compact FIVE MATERIAL palette ONLY: deep navy #172638 outline/shadow/hairhorse, archer blue #3976b5, warm white #e4e1c8, skin #dda77d, ONE muted coral red #b96369. Warm white large contiguous regions, avoid gray; red hair is uniform solid red. Matte cloth and hair, no shiny white freckles, no dithering, no glow, no gradients, no metallic sparkles. Clean expressive readable pixel clusters and modest detail like the approved archer, not high-resolution painted texture. Maintain sensible horse-to-rider proportions; wings are FEATHERED and much longer than rider arm. Whole spear and all wing tips inside each cell. Keep design suitable to register into 96px map sprites and 320x384 combat sprites.
material: Edit the reference sheet as a restrained MATERIAL/COLOR pass, preserving all EIGHT mounted Pegasus poses, orientation, leg joints, wing positions, rider clothing silhouette and full spear shape EXACTLY. The original sheet is our existing original-motion-matched sprite geometry, not a prompt to invent new poses. Keep the same 4 columns x2 rows layout, same view in each cell. Transparent background; remove black ground shadows and any numbers/captions. Each horse-rider-spear figure remains complete. Change all rider red clothing/boots to archer BLUE #3976b5 with connected warm WHITE #e4e1c8 armor/cuffs; keep natural peach skin #dda77d and visible dark eyes. Hair is a single uniform muted coral RED #b96369 with no highlights. Deep navy #172638 outlines, horse mane/tail, hoof soles, spear shaft. White feathered wings and horse, sparse navy contours/necessary blue shadows. Strict 5 colors only, matte/no gradient/no shine/no speckled white glints. The new concept sheet defines the blue-white/coral material direction; the FIRST existing sheet defines every pose and shape. Do not turn the back view into a front face; do not change horse legs, pose timing, wingtip coordinates or weapon direction. No added decorative feathers or designs. Clean grouped pixel clusters, no painterly feather shading, no gray.
geometry_policy: Use existing native-registered ImageGen anatomy for production. New generation is a material/design guide; its first back-view turned toward the viewer and is rejected as motion geometry. Preserve the existing source-facing anatomy and apply compact matte materials through the editable importer.
